limitations: Admission is prospective. The probe uses the original 12-angle circuit and checks baseline state and class-0 logit parity. Circuit feasibility requires a positive row from this run. The earlier 32/32 state-port result used the same exposed TRAIN cases and supplies no circuit witness.

All 32 cases remain in the denominator. Cases with more than 11 mention tokens, empty context, or failed conditioning or projected-gradient gates are recorded as inapplicable. The horizontal state-Jacobian rank describes the checkpoint locally.

On the admitted full-row-rank branch, the SVD right inverse gives the tangent projector and the fixed chord correction. A positive requires the measured mention-intensity and norm residual to be at most 1e-12, energy to fall by more than 1e-10, the absolute class-0 logit change to reach 1e-6, and every angle to lie strictly inside (-π, π). Zero positives would close only the frozen step and 36-update construction.

A positive would witness a perturbation of one relation effect for one case. It preserves raw mention intensities to tolerance while context changes can alter normalized mention attention. The other relation logits stay fixed, so the class-0 change shifts their pairwise margins without establishing favorable classification utility, held-out performance, or L4/L5 acceptance.
